channel.title: The Valley Times-News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Valley Times-News (valleytimes-news.com)

item.title: Community volunteers team up to distribute over 1,300 meals
item.description: Community volunteers and Valley groups teamed up with the Food Bank of East Alabama to distribute over 1,300 ready-to-eat meals to about 320 families in a single day.

item.title: Parade committee donates to food assistance groups
item.description: GVACC Christmas parade committee donated $3,000 to Chambers County food assistance groups, splitting funds between Interfaith Food Closet and Christian Service Center.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Dean Collins: Giving What God Gave First
item.description: Dean Collins reflects on Exodus 25 and the Sermon on the Mount to show how God supplies what we give and calls believers to heart-led generosity with all they have.

item.title: Humane Society handles abandonment surge
item.description: Chattahoochee Humane Society faces a surge in animal abandonments, overcrowded kennels and rising parvovirus risk as it turns to local officials, fundraisers and community support for help.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Skiing out West
item.description: Nostalgic reflections on Western skiing, Rocky Mountain vistas, and how age and $300 lift tickets have turned once-regular skiers into armchair observers.

item.title: Lanett girls headed to area championship game
item.description: The Lanett girls are moving on in the area tournament after defeating Loachapoka 48-20 on Thursday at home.

item.title: LaFayette girls defeated just shy of area championship game
item.description: The LaFayette girls came just short of advancing to the area championship game and a state playoff berth, falling to Reeltown 43-40 in the first round of the area tournament on Thursday at Lanett High School.

item.title: Super Bowl LX Preview: Seahawks, Patriots, and Key Storylines
item.description: The Atlanta Falcons may have fallen short of the Super Bowl, but the season still reshaped how the league looks heading into February.

item.title: Winkles shares passion for goat hair crafts
item.description: At a Valley Lions Club meeting, Troup County’s Rachel Winkles described how she shears her Angora goats and turns their hair into soft scarves, tartans and other handwoven crafts.

item.title: LaFayette City Council reviews project options
item.description: LaFayette council weighs a $2 million waterline project against tight grant deadlines and ALDOT’s paving schedule, balancing cost risks with aging pipes.
